source: London Borough of Camden declarations. Regent's Park: camden.gov.uk/regents-park-2026-by-election-results. Camden Square and Kentish Town South: news.camden.gov.uk/by-election-results-camden-square-kentish-town-south-kilburn/. Both read 4 September 2026.
note: Every by-election held in a Holborn and St Pancras ward since the 2022 all-out elections. The Kilburn by-election of the same day, 5 September 2024, is excluded: Kilburn is in Hampstead and Highgate, not this seat. All are single-member contests, so shares are of ballot papers, not of best candidates.
